event_records.description: User and Partner are at the point of deciding whether to move in together. No concrete steps have been taken yet.

user.name: User
user.persona_brief:
You are User.
User is considering moving in with their partner. User has private hopes, fears, and expectations about the cohabitation, but has not yet made a final decision. User may be looking for signs of compatibility or regret.

partner.name: Partner
partner.persona_brief:
You are Partner.
Partner is the user's romantic partner. Partner has their own private feelings and expectations about moving in together, but has not yet expressed any doubts or confirmations beyond what has been discussed.

resolution.question: Will I regret moving in with my partner?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that User has expressed regret (e.g., told someone they regret moving in, or taken action to move out) after moving in. Resolve NO if no such expression of regret occurs by the cutoff, or if they do not move in at all.
